name: io.github.cryptoduke01/gloam
title: Gloam
description: Private stablecoin payments for people and AI agents on mainnet, hosted or local with limits.

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Default network for tools: tempo-mainnet or robinhood-mainnet (real money), tempo or robinhood (testnet, the default when unset).

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's key. With GLOAM_TEMPO_ACCOUNT it is a Tempo access key bound by the owner's onchain limits. Optional: without it the tools only read and plan.

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_TEMPO_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: The owner's Tempo account that authorized the agent key in the AccountKeychain.

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_NOTE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 32 random bytes in hex that encrypt the server's note store.
